title: Template Service + Built-in Templates + Slice (F-006 Core)
description: Build the template/scaffold backend: template service with CRUD operations for TipTap JSON templates, 5 built-in templates bundled as static JSON, filesystem-based user template storage, and Zustand slice for template state management.
action: Create src/services/templateService.ts with CRUD logic (listTemplates, getTemplate, saveTemplate, deleteTemplate, duplicateTemplate). Create 5 built-in templates as static JSON in src/templates/builtins/. Create src/stores/app/templateSlice.ts with template state. Add types for Template, TemplatePlaceholder, TemplateCategory to src/types/project.ts.

criteria: src/services/templateService.ts exists and exports listTemplates, getTemplate, saveTemplate, deleteTemplate functions
src/templates/builtins/ directory contains at least 5 JSON files (basic-chapter.json, three-act.json, hero-journey.json, parallel-timeline.json, epistolary.json)
src/stores/app/templateSlice.ts exists and exports createTemplateSlice and TemplateSlice type
src/stores/app/appStore.ts contains createTemplateSlice and TemplateSlice in AppState type
src/types/project.ts contains Template and TemplatePlaceholder type definitions
Each built-in template JSON has required fields: id, title, description, category, content, placeholders, isBuiltIn
convergence.verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit and verify no type errors. Grep for all exported functions and verify they exist. Check each built-in template JSON for required fields.
convergence.definition_of_done: Template service can CRUD templates from filesystem and bundled built-ins, built-in templates have correct schema, and Zustand slice exposes template state to the app

files.change: New file: listTemplates (merged builtins + user templates), getTemplate by id, saveTemplate (writes user template to Tauri appDataDir), deleteTemplate (user templates only), duplicateTemplate (clone builtin as user template). Cache path: projects/{projectId}/templates/{templateId}.json
New file: Simple chapter template with title and body paragraphs. Placeholders: chapter_title, opening_line
New file: Setup/Confrontation/Resolution structure with headings and placeholder prompts. Placeholders: protagonist_name, central_conflict, resolution_type
New file: 12-stage hero's journey with section headings. Placeholders: hero_name, mentor_name, ordeal_description, reward_description
New file: Two-timeline structure with alternating sections. Placeholders: timeline_a_label, timeline_b_label, convergence_point
New file: Letter/diary entry format with date and salutation. Placeholders: sender_name, recipient_name, date, closing
New file: Imports all 5 built-in JSON templates and exports as BUILTIN_TEMPLATES: Template[] array

New file: Zustand slice with templates (Template[]), selectedTemplateId (string|null), isLoadingTemplates, loadTemplates(projectId), selectTemplate(id), saveAsTemplate(template), deleteTemplate(id) actions
Import and spread createTemplateSlice, add TemplateSlice to AppState union type

Add Template {id, title, description, category: TemplateCategory, content: Record<string,unknown>, placeholders: TemplatePlaceholder[], isBuiltIn: boolean, createdAt, updatedAt}, TemplatePlaceholder {name, label, defaultValue, type: 'text'|'number'|'select', options?: string[]}, TemplateCategory = 'structure'|'genre'|'format'|'custom'

implementation: 1. Add types to src/types/project.ts: TemplateCategory = 'structure'|'genre'|'format'|'custom', TemplatePlaceholder {name: string, label: string, defaultValue: string, type: 'text'|'number'|'select', options?: string[]}, Template {id: string, title: string, description: string, category: TemplateCategory, content: Record<string,unknown>, placeholders: TemplatePlaceholder[], isBuiltIn: boolean, createdAt: string, updatedAt: string}

2. Create 5 built-in template JSON files in src/templates/builtins/: each with id (e.g. 'builtin-basic-chapter'), title, description, category, content (TipTap JSON with {{placeholder}} text nodes), placeholders array, isBuiltIn: true. Content uses simple TipTap doc structure: {type:'doc', content:[{type:'heading',attrs:{level:2},content:[{type:'text',text:'{{chapter_title}}'}]},{type:'paragraph',content:[{type:'text',text:'{{opening_line}}'}]}]}
3. Create src/templates/builtins/index.ts: import all 5 JSON files, export const BUILTIN_TEMPLATES: Template[] = [basicChapter, threeAct, heroJourney, parallelTimeline, epistolary]

4. Create src/services/templateService.ts: (a) listTemplates(projectId?) — returns [...BUILTIN_TEMPLATES, ...userTemplates] where userTemplates are read from Tauri appDataDir projects/{projectId}/templates/ directory. (b) getTemplate(id, projectId?) — check builtins first by id, then user templates. (c) saveTemplate(template, projectId) — write to projects/{projectId}/templates/{template.id}.json with updatedAt timestamp. (d) deleteTemplate(id, projectId) — remove file from user templates (builtins cannot be deleted). (e) duplicateTemplate(sourceId, projectId) — clone a builtin as user template with new id and isBuiltIn:false. Use ensureDir + writeTextFile/readTextFile from projectFileService pattern.

5. Create src/stores/app/templateSlice.ts: state = {templates: Template[], selectedTemplateId: string|null, isLoadingTemplates: boolean}. Actions: loadTemplates(projectId) — calls templateService.listTemplates, stores result. selectTemplate(id) — sets selectedTemplateId. saveAsTemplate(template, projectId) — calls templateService.saveTemplate, reloads. deleteTemplate(id, projectId) — calls templateService.deleteTemplate, reloads.

6. Modify src/stores/app/appStore.ts: import {createTemplateSlice, TemplateSlice} from './app/templateSlice', add ...createTemplateSlice(...args) to create<AppState>(), add TemplateSlice to AppState type union

unit: templateService.listTemplates returns builtin templates when no user templates exist
templateService.saveTemplate writes to filesystem and reload returns saved template
templateService.deleteTemplate removes user template but not builtin
templateService.duplicateTemplate creates user copy of builtin with isBuiltIn:false
success_metrics: npx tsc --noEmit has no errors in new files
All 5 built-in templates have valid JSON with required fields

reference.pattern: projectFileService.ts pattern: Tauri filesystem operations with hashContent caching

rationale.chosen_approach: Static JSON imports for builtins (zero runtime cost) + Tauri filesystem for user templates. TipTap JSON content means zero conversion when applying template to editor.
decision_factors: TipTap JSON as template format (locked decision from analysis)
Built-in templates bundled as static JSON imports (locked decision)
rationale.tradeoffs: Static imports increase bundle size slightly (~5KB for 5 templates) but avoids async loading complexity

risks: TipTap JSON schema version changes between upgrades — mitigate by keeping template content simple (heading + paragraph nodes only)
User template corruption on filesystem — mitigate with JSON.parse validation on read
